subject: the Myriarch's fire breath, an overlay image of its attack
license: own procedural render of the project (no third-party material); shipped with the Myriarch art set
design: 70 soft glowing balls along a cone 2.3 m long and up to 0.9 m wide from the mouth, white-yellow at the root cooling to dark red at the tip, pointing along the head of the Myriarch's attack frame 5 tilted 10 deg down; frames: ignite, grow, full, full, flicker, burning off from the root twice; (share of the length reached, share burnt off at the root, opacity) = [(0.55, 0.0, 1.0), (1.0, 0.0, 1.0), (1.0, 0.04, 0.95), (1.0, 0.12, 0.9), (0.95, 0.3, 0.65), (0.9, 0.55, 0.35)]
renderer: Eevee, 16 samples, Standard view transform, transparent film; rendered at 1008 px (160 px per metre), the camera shifted per direction so that the breath's root is the canvas centre, reduced by 2 to the HD2 canvas

directions.mirrored: facings 17..31 = horizontal flip of facings 15..1 about the pivot

files.pivotNote: pivot = the breath's root at the mouth, the image's origin, which the Myriarch's script places with the overlay offsets of its frames (overlay-offsets.json of the unit set)

layers.note: bright black with the colour's alpha, emissive the premultiplied colour (A 255 where lit), normal flat (128, 128, 255, 128), specular (0, 0, 0, 255), ao_depth G 255 and A 0.35 inside, the renderer's default outside

fire.note: plays once; the image ends after its last frame
